selector.champion: Primary Central Nervous System Post-Transplant Lymphoproliferative Disorder
selector.rationale: The patient's history of chemotherapy and autologous peripheral blood stem cell transplant, along with the presence of κ light chain–restricted B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation, supports the diagnosis of Primary Central Nervous System Post-Transplant Lymphoproliferative Disorder.

rejected.label: Leptomeningeal Carcinomatosis
rejected.why: Flow cytometry showed κ light chain–restricted B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation, which contradicts carcinomatosis

rejected.label: Intravascular Lymphoma
rejected.why: Diffuse leptomeningeal enhancement is not typical for intravascular lymphoma

rejected.label: Neurolymphomatosis
rejected.why: While it shares some features, the specific history and lab results point more strongly to Primary Central Nervous System Post-Transplant Lymphoproliferative Disorder
